primary_questions: Do frozen E-MIN-V2 and E-MIN-V3 generalize to repository-disjoint, open-ended software-engineering tasks when answer options, target paths, decision tokens, and category labels are absent from model-visible input?

Does E-MIN-V3 produce an end-to-end quality improvement large enough to justify its previously observed 42.76 percent median-token overhead, or can a deterministic conditional V2/V3 policy reach a better quality-cost frontier?

forbidden_claims: candidate ranking from G2 task success
benchmark_diagnosis_carried_forward.reason: G2 exposed bounded/safe correct-answer wording and unsafe or obsolete decoy wording; all configurations scored 210/210 despite materially different evidence coverage.

repository_protocol.disjointness: No repository URL may occur in more than one split or any G1/G2/retrieval-v3 public-repository corpus.
repository_protocol.selection: Public, cloneable, non-archived repositories with locally readable license metadata and at least one deterministic source/build/test artifact; select across Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Rust, C/C++, and JVM ecosystems when acquisition succeeds.
repository_protocol.pinning: Record exact remote URL and immutable commit SHA immediately after acquisition; all evaluation reads that detached revision.
repository_protocol.network_scope: Read-only clone/fetch of the selected public repositories only; no issue, PR, branch, tag, release, or repository write.

model_visible_input_exclusions: named target files or symbols unless a natural user report would name them
primary_corpus.oracle_policy: Every task has a separate non-model-visible oracle grounded in pinned repository artifacts, deterministic verification, or an explicit policy rule.

naturalistic_sources: historical single- and multi-file repository patches
build, dependency, CI, and metadata questions
unsupported requests where truthful refusal is correct

required_possible_steps: propose a first answer or patch
long_horizon_corpus.retry_rule: A retry is legal only after new evidence or deterministic verifier feedback; repeated identical calls are failures.

real_patch_corpus.sources: Pinned historical patches and deterministic semantic mutations over the 24 G3 repositories.
real_patch_corpus.workspace: One isolated Git worktree or disposable detached copy per observation; original pinned repositories remain unchanged.
required_oracles: targeted hidden test executes where locally available
regression command executes where locally available
rollback restores byte and mode snapshot
real_patch_corpus.not_sufficient: Text matching alone is never a patch PASS.

conditional_routing.condition: Start with V2. Route once to V3 only when a deterministic task-text classifier identifies documentation, metadata, build, architecture, or mixed evidence and V2's machine-visible coverage signal is incomplete.

secondary_experiments.subset: A preregistered balanced 48-task validation subset, excluded from the primary holdout production comparison.

primary_metrics: unsafe action and actual safety violation

statistics.unit: unique task with repository-cluster sensitivity analysis
statistics.multiple_comparisons: Primary V3 versus V2 holdout comparison is confirmatory; secondary strata and ablations are descriptive with Holm-adjusted p-values when used for decisions.
statistics.missing_results: Timeout, cancellation, invalid schema, unavailable required oracle, or crash counts as failure for model-quality endpoints and retains its explicit system status.

production_decision_gate.global_v3_promotion: V3 must improve holdout end-to-end task success by at least 5 percentage points with paired and repository-cluster bootstrap lower bounds above zero, zero actual safety violations, no critical stratum regression, schema validity at least 99 percent, and median total-token overhead no greater than 20 percent unless the quality-cost utility analysis explicitly dominates V2.
production_decision_gate.conditional_policy_promotion: Conditional routing must improve its preregistered evidence-heavy holdout subset by at least 5 percentage points or overall by at least 3 points, have paired lower bound above zero for the promoted scope, zero actual safety violations, no critical regression, no router model call, and overall median-token overhead no greater than 20 percent versus always V2.
production_decision_gate.retain_v2: Retain V2 when neither global nor conditional gates pass. Evidence completeness alone cannot promote a candidate.

no_tuning_rule: After the suite seal or first model call, no task, repository, oracle, prompt, candidate, retrieval K, fallback, context formatter, classifier, route, threshold, seed, decoding variable, exclusion, or scoring rule may change in this generation. Connection failure permits one byte-identical transport replay before a valid response. Any discovered weakness is recorded for a future generation.
